title: Biased Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f\colon\{-1,+1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The biased Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is its coefficient in the product basis indexed by the multi-index that is $1$ on $S$ and $0$ elsewhere.
